description:
Lisa Minci is a playable Electro character in Genshin Impact .

A powerful mage recognized as Sumeru Akademiya 's most distinguished graduate in 200 years, Lisa has since returned to Mondstadt to become the humble Librarian of the Knights of Favonius .

She can be obtained for free in the Archon Quest Sparks Amongst the Pages in Prologue : Act I - The Outlander Who Caught the Wind .
role_summary: Lisa Minci is a playable Electro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Lightning Touch
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 4 lightning attacks that deal Electro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time. Plunging Attack Gathering the might of Electro, Lisa plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.

talents.name: Violet Arc
talents.description: Channels the power of lightning to sweep bothersome matters away. (‍ Press Text for mouse and keyboard and controller ‍/‍ Tap Text for touch screen ‍) Releases a homing Lightning Orb. On hit, it deals Electro DMG and applies a stack of the Conductive status (max 3 stacks) to opponents in a small AoE . Hold After an extended casting time, calls down lightning from the heavens, dealing massive Electro DMG to all nearby opponents. Deals great amounts of extra damage to opponents based on the number of Conductive stacks applied to them, and clears their Conductive status.

talents.name: Lightning Rose
talents.description: Summons a Lightning Rose that unleashes powerful lightning bolts, launching surrounding opponents and dealing Electro DMG . The Lightning Rose will continuously emit lightning to knock back opponents and deal Electro DMG throughout the ability's duration.

talents.name: Induced Aftershock
talents.description: Hits by Charged Attacks apply Violet Arc 's Conductive status to opponents.

talents.name: Static Electricity Field
talents.description: Opponents hit by Lightning Rose have their DEF decreased by 15% for 10s.

talents.name: General Pharmaceutics
talents.description: When Lisa crafts a potion , she has a 20% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

c1.name: Infinite Circuit
c1.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Lisa regenerates 2 Energy for every opponent hit while holding Violet Arc . A maximum of 10 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time. There is a 0.4 seconds delay before the Energy generation. If Lisa is switched out during this delay, the Energy generation will not occur.

c2.name: Electromagnetic Field
c2.effect: Holding Violet Arc has the following effects: Increases DEF by 25%. Increases Lisa's resistance to interruption .

c3.name: Resonant Thunder
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Lightning Rose by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Plasma Eruption
c4.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Lightning Rose now unleashes 1-3 lightning bolts when it attacks. If there is only 1 enemy within the radius, Lightning Rose may only produce 1 discharge at a time to the enemy. If there are only 2 enemies within the radius, Lightning Rose may produce 1 or 2 discharges in total at a time. For each instance, there is a ~17.5% chance for it to produce 1 discharge and a ~82.5% chance to produce 2 discharges. If there are 3 or more enemies within the radius, Lightning Rose may produce 1, 2, or 3 discharges in total at a time. This scenario carries two sets of randomizations: One that randomizes between shooting 1 or 2 Discharges, following a 50% and 50% occurrence rate, and the other randomizing between 1, 2, and 3 Discharges, following a 25%, 50%, and 25% occurrence rate, respective to the number of Discharges. The first Arc released from a Lightning Rose will...

c5.name: Electrocute
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Violet Arc by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Pulsating Witch
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview When Lisa takes the field, she applies 3 stacks of Violet Arc 's Conductive status onto nearby opponents. This effect can only occur once every 5s. The effect of this constellation has a horizontal radius of 5m and unlimited vertical range. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Pulsating Witch Preview.mp4
